audience: online sellers who sell products and subscriptions with SamCart

useCases.title: Review orders and daily sales
useCases.text: Read the daily sales report for a date range. List the orders by email, product or status to see the details.

useCases.title: Look up a customer and their subscriptions
useCases.text: Find the customer by exact email and open the record. List the subscriptions of that customer.

useCases.title: Track subscription status changes
useCases.text: List the subscriptions with a status filter. Read the history of one subscription to see its status changes.

useCases.title: Check recurring revenue
useCases.text: Read the monthly recurring revenue of the active subscriptions. Compare it with the daily sales of the same period.

useCases.title: Set custom fields on an order
useCases.text: Open an order to read its custom field slugs. Set the values you need. An empty value erases the stored value.

useCases.title: Schedule or cancel a subscription
useCases.text: Schedule a cancellation at the end of the billing period or on a future date. Cancel now only when needed, because this tool has no undo.
